question: Will the U.S. personal saving rate (BEA, seasonally adjusted) for November 2024 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2024-11-14) be above 6.2%, its value for August 2024?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2024-10-15 (August 2024), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
